extracted.name: Taco Lasagna
extracted.description: This Mexican-American inspired dish was so fun to make for Cinco de Mayo🇲🇽! It was my first time making lasagna and it turned out amazing & delicious 🤤 share your results!
ingredient_lines: 1 box oven-ready lasagna pasta (no boiling required!)
1/2 cup chicken broth (can substitute with water)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375. Cook ground beef and drain excess oil
In the same pan, add diced onions & bell pepper. Cook until soft
Add cooked ground beef and season with all dry ingredients.
Add tomato & 80% of the taco sauce, leave the rest for later. simmer on medium-low heat for about 7 minutes
Spray baking pan with non stick cooking spray. Layer the pan with pasta, cooked meat, ricotta cheese, & mozzarella cheese. Repeat this step 2-3 times.
Add chicken broth or water to remaining taco sauce. Top off the pan with pasta, taco sauce mixture, & 1/2 taco blend cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes. Add remaining cheese packet and cook for an additional 15 minutes or until cheese melts.
